items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: He's going on a studio with Kate Smith. Oh, I was going to say, it looks like Kate Smith.

ctx.x: That's when I was with Longhands Band. Oh, yeah. Featuring me around there. Mm-hmm. He's going on a studio with Kate Smith. Oh, I was going to say, it looks like Kate Smith. Yeah. Nat Bruslov. It's me sitting right here.
